```powershell
Write-Output '=== JOB 545 - THE TERMINAL ATTACHES TO THE REAL GAME AND THE ALL ON PATCH GETS ITS BODIES (Ground: job 543 printed the live proof, the terminal attached to the launcher four times while health and ammo stayed off, and the godmode button arms only what is already hunted. This job seats a redirect in the attach path so a launcher target hands over to the real game process in the same folder, prints the full attach and godmode bodies plus the hunt method names for the all on patch, and rebuilds plus relaunches only on a clean build with the live files untouched on any miss. No game relaunch rides this job. Every variable carries the p545 prefix.) ==='
$p545b64 = ''
$p545patcher = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch545.cs'
[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($p545patcher, [Convert]::FromBase64String($p545b64))
$p545src = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal3.cs'
$p545tmp = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal3.p545.cs'
$p545verdict = 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch545.verdict.txt'
$p545csc = 'C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe'
& $p545csc /nologo /out:'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch545.exe' $p545patcher
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'PATCHER BUILD FAILED' } else {
  & 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\patch545.exe' $p545src $p545tmp $p545verdict
  $p545v = ''
  if (Test-Path $p545verdict) { $p545v = Get-Content $p545verdict }
  Write-Output ('VERDICT ' + $p545v)
  if ($p545v -eq 'PATCH OK') {
    & $p545csc /nologo /target:winexe /reference:System.Windows.Forms.dll /reference:System.Drawing.dll /out:'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.p545.exe' $p545tmp
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output 'CSC FAILED - LIVE FILES UNTOUCHED' } else {
      Copy-Item $p545src 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal3.cs.bak545' -Force
      Copy-Item $p545tmp $p545src -Force
      Copy-Item 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.p545.exe' 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.exe' -Force
      $p545old = @(Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
      foreach ($p545o in $p545old) { Stop-Process -Id $p545o.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
      Start-Sleep -Seconds 2
      $p545still = @(Get-Process -Name 'PhiTerminal' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
      if ($p545still.Count -eq 0) {
        $p545new = Start-Process -FilePath 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.exe' -PassThru
        Write-Output ('TERMINAL LAUNCHED pid=' + $p545new.Id)
      } else { Write-Output 'OLD STILL RUNNING - NEW EXE READY, NO LAUNCH' }
      $p545exe = Get-Item 'C:\Users\Admin\PhiTerminal\PhiTerminal.exe'
      Write-Output ('EXE BYTES=' + $p545exe.Length + ' WRITE=' + $p545exe.LastWriteTime)
    }
  } else { Write-Output 'PATCH HELD - LIVE FILES UNTOUCHED' }
}
Write-Output 'PHI P545 VERDICT: ATTACH REDIRECT AND BODIES ABOVE'
Write-Output 'JOB 545 DONE'
```
